title: The Street Treehouse
premise: Ollie, Priya and Tobe are building a treehouse for the whole street out of leftovers. Every video, the top comment decides what they build next.
rules: One small, real step per episode. No early launches, no sudden wins.
Counters on screen come from series.json only. Never invent a number.
Open with a one-line recap of the last episode, then the new problem inside 3 seconds.
End on an open question the comments can answer.
Thank the commenter whose idea decided this episode, by the comment, not a fake name.

episodes.title: The oak by the creek
episodes.summary: We picked the big oak by the creek. Priya measured it twice and Ollie lost the tape measure.

episodes.title: A floor made of pallets
episodes.summary: We built the floor out of old pallets. It wobbles, but it holds Ollie.
episodes.openLoop: How do we get up there: a ladder, a rope or a slide?

decidedBy.comment: Build the floor first so nobody falls
decidedBy.author: @maplemornings

decidedBy.comment: A rope ladder first, then a slide for coming down
decidedBy.author: @kitchenfloordj

next.brief: Build the rope ladder. End with the slide not fitting.
